description: This file defines the utility class 'ParamChecker' that provides static methods to validate parameters such as null checks, emptiness checks, and range validations, mainly to ensure proper argument validation throughout a Java project.

classes.name: ParamChecker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parameter validation including null checks, emptiness checks for various data types, and range checks for bits.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Checks if the given object parameter is null; throws IllegalArgumentException if null.

methods.name: checkNotNull (varargs)
methods.description: Checks multiple parameters for null; uses checkNotNull for each element.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (String)
methods.description: Checks if a string parameter is null or empty; throws IllegalArgumentException if invalid.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (Object array)
methods.description: Checks if an object array is null or has zero length.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (Collection)
methods.description: Checks if a collection is null or empty.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (Map)
methods.description: Checks if a map is null or empty.

methods.name: checkGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Checks if an integer parameter is greater than zero.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty (byte array)
methods.description: Checks if a byte array is null or has zero length.

methods.name: checkBit
methods.description: Checks if the bit value is between 0 and 7 inclusive.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (String)
methods.description: Returns true if the string is null or has zero length.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (Collection)
methods.description: Returns true if the collection is null or empty.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (Map)
methods.description: Returns true if the map is null or empty.

methods.name: isValidBit
methods.description: Returns true if the integer is between 0 and 7 inclusive.
